title: Quiz 3 — Chemistry Discoveries & Applications
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Louis Pasteur is best known for which scientific idea?
options: Germ theory of disease
Theory of relativity
Theory of evolution
Atomic theory of matter
questions.correct: Germ theory of disease

questions.text: Which old belief did Pasteur's swan-neck flask experiment disprove?
options: Spontaneous generation
Conservation of energy
Cell theory of life
Law of definite proportions
questions.correct: Spontaneous generation

questions.text: In the swan-neck flask, why did the boiled broth stay clear even though air could enter?
options: Dust and microbes were trapped in the curved neck
The broth was too hot for any air to enter it
The glass of the flask slowly killed all the microbes
Oxygen in the air turned the broth into a solid
questions.correct: Dust and microbes were trapped in the curved neck

questions.text: What does pasteurization do to milk?
options: Heats it to kill most harmful microorganisms
Removes all of the fat and the water from it
Adds vitamins so the milk lasts much longer
Freezes it so microbes cannot grow at all
questions.correct: Heats it to kill most harmful microorganisms

questions.text: How does a vaccine protect the body?
options: It trains the immune system with a weakened germ
It kills every germ already inside the body
It replaces the immune system with stronger medicine
It makes the blood too acidic for germs to live
questions.correct: It trains the immune system with a weakened germ

questions.text: Pasteurized milk left on the table overnight turned sour. What BEST explains this?
options: Not every microbe is killed, so the survivors multiplied
Pasteurization adds bacteria that sour the milk on purpose
Heat from pasteurization made the milk chemically unstable
Pasteurized milk reacts with air to make lactic acid directly
questions.correct: Not every microbe is killed, so the survivors multiplied

questions.text: A vendor says, "Boiling milk for an hour is better than pasteurizing it." Which judgment is BEST?
options: Partly true — it is safe, but taste and nutrients suffer
Fully true — longer heating is always the better method to use
False — boiling cannot kill any microbes in the milk
False — pasteurized milk contains no microbes at all
questions.correct: Partly true — it is safe, but taste and nutrients suffer

questions.text: What is the active ingredient in household liquid bleach?
options: Sodium hypochlorite
Sodium hydrogen carbonate
Sodium chloride
Sodium fluoride
questions.correct: Sodium hypochlorite

questions.text: Why does soap remove oily dirt that water alone cannot?
options: Its molecules attract both oil and water
It raises the temperature of the water
It turns the oily dirt into crystals
It makes the oily dirt evaporate into the air
questions.correct: Its molecules attract both oil and water

questions.text: Which Philippine agency registers cosmetics such as shampoo and toothpaste?
options: Food and Drug Administration
Department of Trade and Industry
Department of Environment and Natural Resources
Department of Science and Technology
questions.correct: Food and Drug Administration

questions.text: Why does fluoride in toothpaste help prevent cavities?
options: It makes tooth enamel resist acid
It kills every germ in the mouth
It whitens teeth by bleaching them
It scrubs plaque off like sandpaper
questions.correct: It makes tooth enamel resist acid

questions.text: What gas makes a cake rise when baking powder is used?
options: Carbon dioxide (CO₂)
Oxygen (O₂)
Hydrogen (H₂)
Chlorine gas (Cl₂)
questions.correct: Carbon dioxide (CO₂)

questions.text: A bleach label says "Do not mix with acids." Your toilet cleaner contains hydrochloric acid. What should you do?
options: Use them on separate days and rinse well between
Mix them for a stronger cleaning solution
Mix them, but only if the bathroom window is wide open
Add water to the mixture to make it safe
questions.correct: Use them on separate days and rinse well between

questions.text: A river near a laundry area has thick green algae and dying fish. Which chain of events BEST explains this?
options: Phosphates feed algae; dead algae decay and use up oxygen
Soap bubbles block sunlight, so fish cannot see any food
Detergent makes the water too cold for fish to survive
Fragrance in the detergent poisons only the fish, not algae
questions.correct: Phosphates feed algae; dead algae decay and use up oxygen

questions.text: What type of chemical reaction inside a battery produces an electric current?
options: Redox (oxidation–reduction)
Neutralization (acid–base)
Combustion (burning in air)
Precipitation (solid forming)
questions.correct: Redox (oxidation–reduction)

questions.text: In an aircon, how does the refrigerant cool the room?
options: It absorbs heat as it evaporates inside
It produces cold by burning electricity
It releases cold air made from the fan
It freezes the room air into small ice
questions.correct: It absorbs heat as it evaporates inside

questions.text: Which energy chain describes a jeepney engine?
options: Chemical → heat → kinetic
Kinetic → chemical → light
Electrical → sound → heat
Light → electrical → chemical
questions.correct: Chemical → heat → kinetic

questions.text: Salt farmers in Pangasinan let seawater stand in shallow beds. How does salt form?
options: The sun evaporates water and salt crystallizes
Seawater reacts with sand to make new salt
Wind blows salt crystals in from the sea
Rain adds more salt that settles at the bottom of the bed
questions.correct: The sun evaporates water and salt crystallizes

questions.text: Toasting bread makes it brown and fragrant. Which statement uses BOTH physics and chemistry correctly?
options: Heat transfer starts the Maillard browning reaction
The bread absorbs light and changes its color
The toaster sprays a coat of brown sugar onto the bread
Water in the bread turns brown when it boils away
questions.correct: Heat transfer starts the Maillard browning reaction

questions.text: A barangay health center with frequent brownouts must keep vaccines cold. Which design BEST combines physics and chemistry?
options: Solar-powered fridge with insulation and frozen gel packs
An electric fan blowing over an open plastic box of vaccines
A metal cabinet placed in direct sunlight beside a window
A cooler filled with warm water to keep the temperature even
questions.correct: Solar-powered fridge with insulation and frozen gel packs
